224-1671-1772-8345.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2034-2558-3490-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2558-3490-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1839-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
1839-6034-8089.description:
Activate Kuro by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2111-2829-3545.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

301-2813-7096.easyPrerequisites:
You've had a land enter this turn.
There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2813-7096.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

1778-2459-2997-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-2459-2997-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

4390-4908-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-4908-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-4772-7061.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Solid Ground.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

851-2034-5220-6961-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
851-2034-5220-6961-7422.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4875-7296.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3122-5282-7149.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Undercover Operative into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Undercover Operative dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Undercover Operative enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Undercover Operative leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Undercover Operative from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-6797-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6797-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2919-3490-4659-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4659-5870.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

455-877-4254.description:
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying {0}.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-2562-3967.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

147-6106.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Electroduplicate
147-6106.description:
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Electroduplicate, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Electroduplicate, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1379-1557-1651-5640.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Siren of the Silent Song, targeting Siren of the Silent Song.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

3560-4050-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-2060-5544-6431-6797.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-5544-6431-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

1718-3327-4419-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4419-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2534-3358-5631.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken creature, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Coercive Recruiter and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
When the Skeleton Pirate enters the battlefield, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping target creature and gaining control of it.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
When the Skeleton Pirate enters the battlefield, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Repeat.

659-4050-4896.easyPrerequisites: Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
659-4050-4896.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
659-4050-4896.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing two Goblin tokens, adding {2}{W}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-5326-5400.notablePrerequisites: Synth Infiltrator and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3719-5326-5400.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Synth Infiltrator and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Synth Infiltrator to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

190-3140-6085.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Altanak and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting an opponent's Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing the opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining opponent.

277-4365-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
277-4365-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-4365-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Tiller Engine triggers, untapping both Everywhere tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1323-4565-4762.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-4565-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

1032-2178-3523.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1032-2178-3523.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

628-3374-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken, non-Human white creature.
628-3374-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken, non-Human white creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving the creature persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
 Repeat.

539-930-1636-3346-4147.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
539-930-1636-3346-4147.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Universal Automaton.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Universal Automaton on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Universal Automaton and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1858-4705-5195.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers twice and Harmonic Prodigy triggers once.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Harmonic Prodigy trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve View from Above, giving Storm-Kiln Artist flying until end of turn and returning View from Above to your hand.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2232-3338-3652-4702.notablePrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Mirran Spy.
2232-3338-3652-4702.description:
Activate Mirran Spy by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
The token Mirran Spy enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Each Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki and any other creature(s) you control.
Repeat.

1742-1913-4559.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other artifacts.
1742-1913-4559.description:
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two artifacts, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Metalwork Colossus, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3492-3609-5022.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper and Treasury Thrull do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Treasury Thrull.
3492-3609-5022.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Declare Treasury Thrull as an attacker.
Treasury Thrull triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
In your postcombat main phase, cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

224-1257-3147.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

813-1518-1964-1987.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
813-1518-1964-1987.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
